title: SupplyShield Real-Data Reference Benchmark Set
description: Fixed empirical reference set for real-world PRs and dependency packages. Entries are fixed prior to scan execution.

entries.reason: Routine Dependabot version bump of testing/documentation dependencies without added install scripts, binary introductions, or new network endpoints.
Standard Dependabot patch bump of minor dependencies without lifecycle script modifications, binary introductions, or AST anomalies.

Legitimate update modifying native binding build hooks and install scripts for cross-platform precompiled binary selection; triggers install_hook_modified and native binary scrutiny without malicious intent or unfamiliar exfiltration hosts.
Legitimate package update modifying postinstall engine binary verification step against known Prisma infrastructure without credential harvesting or obfuscated payloads.
Injected lifecycle install hook and encrypted payload targeting cryptocurrency wallet seed exfiltration in Copay/BitPay. Triggers Floor 75/80 (install hook + encoded payload / secret read).

Hijacked PyPI package containing setup.py custom cmdclass harvesting AWS credentials (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) and exfiltrating them to an unassigned raw IP address. Triggers Floor 80 (install hook + secret env read + new network host).
